title: Web products that stay cheap to run
summary: Marketing sites, internal tools and customer-facing calculators — built static where static is enough, serverless where it isn't.
points: Bilingual Arabic/English done properly: logical CSS, correct hreflang, no machine-translated filler
Structured data and technical SEO built into the generator, not bolted on afterwards
Deploys that verify the live response by content and refuse to publish a short build
proof: invoiceready.ae runs 102 pages on $0/month of infrastructure.

title: AI where it beats a rule, and not where it doesn't
summary: Document extraction, classification, drafting and review pipelines — with the boring parts left deterministic.
points: Deterministic checks stay deterministic; the model handles the judgement a linter cannot make
Arabic-language work treated as a first-class problem, not an afterthought translation
Every pipeline ships with the cost per run measured, not estimated
proof: A 24-check invoice validator that runs in the browser — no upload, no model call, no data-handling conversation.

title: AWS architecture and cost engineering
summary: Serverless-first builds, and audits of existing accounts that are quietly overspending.
points: S3 + CloudFront + OAC, Lambda, DynamoDB, SES — locked down by default, public by exception
SPF/DKIM/DMARC and deliverability set up so transactional mail actually arrives
Infrastructure scripted end to end: domain, certificate, CDN and DNS in one resumable command
proof: A production site with a fully closed bucket, forced HTTPS and HTTP/3 — for the price of a DNS zone.

title: Android applications
summary: Native Android where the hardware matters — sensors, background reliability, offline-first.
points: Background work that survives process death, because most step and tracking bugs live there
Offline-first by default: no ads, no analytics, no telemetry unless you ask for it
Correctness held as a checkable invariant rather than a claim in the changelog
proof: Khutwa's stored history reconciles with its live sensor counter to a delta of exactly zero.
